items.title: Who pays the agent
items.text: Whoever orders the agent pays: a landlord's agent cannot charge you. We work only on homes offered to you alone, with the landlord's go-ahead; our fee stays within two months' net cold rent plus VAT: we refund any excess.

items.title: The rent brake
items.text: At signing the rent may not exceed the local comparative rent by more than ten percent, exceptions aside. We check, furniture surcharge included.

items.title: The deposit
items.text: At most three months' cold rent, in three instalments, kept apart from the landlord's money. Anything more is not legal.

items.title: Cold or warm
items.text: The listed rent is often cold. We read the Nebenkosten advance, what it covers, and what the yearly settlement can add.

papers.summary: The papers a German landlord asks for
papers.tail: The rest we go through on the free call.

items.q: When do I pay BOOM Berlin?
items.a: When you order, by card on this page: three flat fees, VAT included. If two months' net cold rent plus VAT come to less than the €500 of Full Search, we refund the difference. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call. A landlord's agent cannot charge you anything: in Germany whoever orders the agent pays.

items.q: What happens on the free call?
items.a: A call with Valentino, by phone or WhatsApp, at a time that suits you both. We hear your dates, budget and who is moving, say which service fits, or that none does, and which papers you are missing. Nothing is charged for the call. Full Search is refunded in full if we decline the search in the first call.

items.q: I just arrived and have no SCHUFA. Can I still rent in Berlin?
items.a: You can apply with a file that shows you can pay: employment contract, recent payslips, bank statements, and a guarantor if asked. Application Pack builds that SCHUFA and guarantor strategy, with the self-disclosure in German. No landlord is obliged to accept a file; the free call says what yours lacks.

items.q: How do I avoid a rental scam in Berlin from abroad?
items.a: Never transfer a deposit or first rent for a flat nobody on your side has seen. With Attended Viewing (€149) a BOOM person visits it in your place, with live video and a written report. With Full Search or Application Pack we also check the lease and the rent brake before you sign.

items.q: What if you don't find anything?
items.a: We tell you in the first call if your budget and timeline don't fit the market; if BOOM declines the search then, the €500 Full Search fee is refunded in full. Once we take it on, the search runs until you sign or stop it, and the fee pays for the work, not for a result.

rows.ddHtml: BOOM Berlin, the tenant-side rental desk of BOOM — operated by Egidi Immobiliare S.r.l., an Italian real estate agency registered in Rome. Hired by the tenant and paid by the tenant only, never by the landlord or the landlord's agent.
Expats and internationals relocating to Berlin — employees, researchers, couples and families — from abroad or already in the city.
English; the self-disclosure and cover note go in German.
Nothing from landlords or platforms. Full Search stays inside the German cap: we refund any excess.

German-format dossier within one working day of your papers, homes a landlord lets us offer to you alone, attended viewings with live video and written report, rent brake and lease checked before you sign, Anmeldung supported.
We don't list homes, we don't represent landlords, we don't collect your rent or deposit, and we don't promise a date.
